description:
Safely store your files and access them from any device.

Choose folders on your computer to sync with Google Drive or backup to Google Photos, and access all of your content directly from your PC or Mac.
- Introduced temporary HideSharedFoldersIconsWindows advanced configuration option. You might use this option to work around increased latency when loading shared folders in Windows Explorer with KB5094126 installed. This option might be removed in a future release.
- Bug fixes and performance improvements
